summary.name: Red Claw
summary.desc: The red fossil of a great beast's claw found in the St. Lamia region.

raw.desc: The red fossil of a great beast's claw found in the St. Lamia region.
raw.name: Red Claw

dictionary.lore: This rare red claw is found in the mountains around St. Lamia, such as the Volcano Eldent or Mt. Wistorea. They are well-known weapon materials. It's said that a renowned Sphere tempered with a Red Claw will gain a powerful effect. They can be found in Elgaia, but are much more common in St. Lamia.
